chunks.name: 🧰️theme-editor-fixtures
chunks.doc: 🧰️ Theme editor fixtures: the accessibility and publication fixtures, the nested settings shell, the control-id walk and the retained control state the theme laws read.

chunks.name: 🎚️theme-publication-and-sections
chunks.doc: 🎚️ Theme publication and sections: retained republish without guest refresh, invalid input, the canonical document, and the colors, spacing, fonts, number, metrics and appearance sections.

chunks.name: 🔁️theme-tokens-and-leaves
chunks.doc: 🔁️ Theme tokens and leaves: re-tokenised painting, the publication ceiling, the reset predicate, the General and Theme leaves and the rows' authored coordinates.

chunks.name: ♿️accessible-names-and-activation
chunks.doc: ♿️ Accessible names and activation: chrome control names and shortcuts, pressed buttons on actual hit ids, focusable field labels and the accessibility and pointer activation routes.

chunks.name: 🪞️mirror-address-liveness
chunks.doc: 🪞️ Mirror address liveness: the settings toggle shell and the accessibility address staying live, stale or delayed across frames.

chunks.name: 🧭️settings-strip-and-keybindings
chunks.doc: 🧭️ Settings strip and keybindings: the constrained tab strip, mobile panel buttons, inline chords, the flagged keybinding rows and accepted dock names.

chunks.name: 📐️passive-regions-and-geometry
chunks.doc: 📐️ Passive regions and geometry: passive chrome regions, compact theme spacing, named metrics and their localized authoring guidance.
